title: Makeup Mirror 8-Inch Freestanding Floor Stand Solid Brass 2X/1X Double-Sided | Allied Brass
description:
Need a clearer view for grooming without drilling into the wall? This freestanding make-up mirror is a floor standing vanity mirror that also works as a magnifying makeup mirror, giving you both a close-up view and a full-face check in one piece—ideal for traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.

This double-sided mirror (also called a makeup mirror or vanity mirror) features 2X magnification on one side for detailed makeup or shaving and 1X magnification on the other for everyday viewing. The heavy base and brass construction keep the mirror steady, and a felt pad protects the surface beneath it.

Highlights:
- Detail work without guesswork: 2X magnifying mirror side for precise grooming and makeup application
- Quick overall check: 1X side for an all-around view
- Flexible placement: freestanding, floor stand design—no wall mount required (not wall-mounted, not wall hanging)
- Stable on the floor: heavy solid brass base designed to help prevent tipping
- Surface protection: felt pad helps prevent scratching

Specs & Details:
- Product type synonyms: make-up mirror, vanity mirror, magnifying makeup mirror
- Mirror size: 8-Inch diameter double faced mirror glass
- Magnification: 2X (one side) / 1X (opposite side)
- Material: solid brass; brass construction
- Mounting style: freestanding floor standing (not wall-mounted)
- Overall dimensions (L x W): 10.5 in x 10.5 in
- Product weight: 13.6 lb
- Included items: Make-up mirror
- Assembly required: Yes
- Finish options: Available in a wide variety of designer finishes, including 25 finish options with statement colors.

_previous.description: Elegantly and efficiently designed, this floor standing 2 sided magnification mirror is an easy solution for your daily make-up or shaving routine.  The dual-sided mirror features a clear magnification for those close-up applications on one side and a 1x magnification on the opposite side for a quick all around check at any angle.  With classic accents, this free-standing vanity mirror is the crowning touch to your bathroom accessories.
